title: Rename Field

solutions.title: Trip renamed, the published log row frozen on purpose
solutions.tradeoff: Trip reads clearly inside this module now, but tripLogRow.ts has to spell out the old warehouse key names by hand on every field instead of forwarding the record as-is, and that translation is one more place a future field could drift out of sync with the published format if nobody remembers why it is there.

reviewFocus: Does TripLogRow still declare dt, st, and en as its own key names, unrenamed - or did the rename bleed across the boundary into the published wire format?
Does anything outside trip.ts still read a trip's duration or station fields directly, by any name, instead of going through newTrip, fareCents, routeSummary, or tripLogRow?
Was Trip's field order preserved through the rename (duration, start, end), or did reordering ride along with renaming in the same commit?
Is newTrip's signature still three positional parameters - a fourth would have been a real Introduce Parameter Object question, not a Rename Field one.
Would you have inlined tripLogRow's field-by-field mapping into a spread with an override, or is naming each key explicitly worth the extra lines here? What does each read like at the call site?
